data.one_liner: Lightweight, zero-dependency extension library providing chainable UI utilities for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It enhances Flutter UI code with expressive, chainable widget extensions that streamline common layout, padding, sizing, and styling patterns using pure Dart. It wraps existing widgets without creating new classes or adding external dependencies.
use_when: You want to write cleaner, more concise widget trees with method chaining.
You need standard layout helpers like padding, centering, and sizing without boilerplate wrappers.
You want a zero-dependency extension library that works with pure Flutter or optional Material/Cupertino modules.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard explicit wrapper widgets like Padding and Center for readability.
You need complete state-management or UI-kit frameworks.
strengths: Provides over 200 chainable utility methods for layout, alignment, visibility, and constraints.
Well-tested with hundreds of unit tests.
weaknesses: Method chaining can make deep widget trees harder to read for some developers.
Relies entirely on extension methods rather than standalone components.
data.setup_notes: Simply add exui to pubspec.yaml and import the core library or material/cupertino extensions.
